coreRules: V7 owns the walkable plateau/base terrain; ElizaWy/LPC cliff art is connected boundary presentation and may not replace semantic terrain authority.
CliffShape15 remains structural/collision topology authority; fresh PCG normalizes one-cell three/four-edge caps before bake rather than inventing pixels for them.
Fresh PCG runtime cliff masks are frozen to 1,2,3,4,5,6,8,9,10,12. Explicit authored thin caps may exist structurally but have no generic visual fallback.
North/east/west straight edges and north convex corners use exact whole authored ElizaWy cells; E+W narrow ridges use the exact companion LPC c8-c10/r2 three-cell row.
South straight faces use the dedicated ElizaWy c10/r9-r11 top/body/foot column; each extra structural tier inserts one complete authored middle module before the fixed foot.
Southwest/southeast faces use exact rounded authored families. Directional ramps use the W7 exact natural-scale 3x4 authored stamps and remain one-tier connectors.
Ordinary generated cave mouths use the exact one-tile-wide c6/r9-r11 recipe regardless of cliff height. Taller cliffs add ordinary rock continuation above; the 3x3 portal is explicit tunnel-only.
No half-tile synthesis, stretching, arbitrary mirror/rotation, or generic visual fallback is permitted inside a certified connected recipe.
Water-facing and waterfall eligibility remain semantic attachments and are not inferred from cliff pixels.
Structural collision and traversal are independent of source alpha/color and seasonal texture selection.

southStraight.receiverPolicy: receiver terrain remains V7 semantic authority; cliff overlay does not paint a substitute shoreline/ground material

orthographicPlateauProjection.rule: V7 owns plateau fill; straight N/W/E rims use the square-plateau edge family while south/front stays on the demo-grounded c2r7 family. Rounded c1/c3 cells remain corner-only.

roundedOuterCornerProjection.rule: Exact mask12/mask6 always use their authored rounded source family. Isolated corners use full depth; repeated diagonal-chain members use compact depth.
roundedOuterCornerProjection.compactSequence: lip + body + foot; shoulder omitted only for repeated generated chain ownership

climbableVines.rule: Do not scatter vines as decoration while they would visually imply climbability. Bind them to a climb connector when the LPC climb animation/gameplay state is promoted.

directionalRampReference.note: Complete left/right diagonal ramp assemblies are active at natural 3x4 scale. Fresh worldgen paints the matching six-cell MountainPath corridor; no c8 one-column crop, mirror, rotation, stretch, or fabricated rounded-corner composition is permitted.

innerCornerComposition.note: N5X promotes only reviewed outer corners. Inferred concave joins remain orthogonal strip composition until a distinct inner-corner source recipe is certified.

runtimeGate.innerCornerComposition: fresh_pcg_inverse_one_cell_notches_normalized_out; remaining turns emerge from adjacent certified contour hosts without synthesized receiver pixels
